item.title: Fort Augustus Fish and Chip Shop Wins Prestigious UK Industry Award
item.description: A Fort Augustus fish and chip shop has earned national recognition after winning a prestigious UK industry award, highlighting Highland talent, quality food, and a local business making its mark on the national stage.The post Fort Augustus Fish and Chip Shop Wins Prestigious UK Industry Award appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Hebridean Whale and Dolphin Trust Celebrates Double Win at ScottishPower Foundation Awards
item.description: An Isle of Mull marine charity has secured £15,000 after a double success at the ScottishPower Foundation Awards, recognising innovative education and conservation work that is inspiring communities and protecting whales and dolphins along Scotland’s west coast.The post Hebridean Whale and Dolphin Trust Celebrates Double Win at ScottishPower Foundation Awards appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Man Jailed for Historic Sexual Offences Against Teenage Girls in Shetland
item.description: A Shetland man has been sentenced to 10 years in prison for historic sexual offences against teenage girls, with police stressing that time is no barrier to justice and praising the courage of victims who came forward decades later.The post Man Jailed for Historic Sexual Offences Against Teenage Girls in Shetland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Man Who Died at Inverness Property Named as Murder Inquiry Continues
item.description: A man who died at a property in Inverness has been named as Iain MacFarlane, as police confirm the case is being treated as murder and continue to support his family during ongoing enquiries.The post Man Who Died at Inverness Property Named as Murder Inquiry Continues appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highlands MSP Calls for Real Improvements in Deaf Access to Local Services
item.description: Deaf people in the Highlands are still struggling to access basic public services, as MSP Emma Roddick calls for urgent improvements to British Sign Language provision and better local access to interpreters, mental health support, and essential services.The post Highlands MSP Calls for Real Improvements in Deaf Access to Local Services appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: National Speed Management Review Sets Out Next Steps to Cut Road Deaths
item.description: The Scottish Government has set out the next steps in its National Speed Management Review, confirming no immediate changes to single carriageway limits while moving forward with plans to raise HGV speeds to help cut road deaths and improve safety.The post National Speed Management Review Sets Out Next Steps to Cut Road Deaths appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Sarwar Urged to Speak Out as Former Welsh First Minister Calls for Internal Market Act to Go
item.description: Pressure is mounting on Scottish Labour after former Welsh First Minister Mark Drakeford called for the UK Internal Market Act to be scrapped, with the SNP urging Anas Sarwar to clarify where he stands on protecting devolution. The post Sarwar Urged to Speak Out as Former Welsh First Minister Calls for Internal Market Act to Go appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Council Reassures Survivors as Domestic Abuse Services Reviewed
item.description: Highland Council has reassured survivors that domestic abuse services will continue as contracts are reviewed, confirming no changes before April 2026 and pledging ongoing support for outreach services and refuge accommodation across the Highlands.The post Highland Council Reassures Survivors as Domestic Abuse Services Reviewed appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: UHI Orkney Secures Funding for New State of The Art Archaeology Laboratory
item.description: UHI Orkney is set to strengthen its global research standing after securing funding for a new state of the art environmental archaeology laboratory, boosting scientific capability, community outreach, and understanding of Orkney’s past and future environment.The post UHI Orkney Secures Funding for New State of The Art Archaeology Laboratory appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Engineers Confirm Scour as Likely Cause of Garmouth Viaduct Collapse
item.description: Moray Council engineers say scour is the likely cause of the Garmouth Viaduct collapse over the River Spey, with further specialist inspections planned and the bridge set to remain closed while safety and future options are assessed.The post Engineers Confirm Scour as Likely Cause of Garmouth Viaduct Collapse appeared first on The Highland Times.
